text:
direct your videos with Seedance 2 and Nano Banana Pro.

here's how: 

> prepare your images with nano banana pro
> add them into your seedance 2
> explain your scenes, transitions in prompt

here's what that looks like: https://t.co/VcfDBFNG4K
content:
Prepare your images with Nano Banana Pro before importing them into Seedance 2.  
Add the prepared images into Seedance 2 as inputs for your video.  
In your Seedance 2 prompt, explicitly describe each scene and the transitions between scenes to direct the video.

thread_texts: get access + start creating at https://t.co/WKO5dpdbJC 👇🏼
